summary.text: On Kamigawa, where the spirit and human realms are at war, Toshiro Umezawa tries to avoid the conflict but becomes its center, and he and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the kami's coming victory.
At Jukai Forest, Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One, who takes the name Kyodai, and together Michiko and Kyodai defeat the eight-headed O-Kagachi by biting off his last heads.
They take O-Kagachi's place as guardian of the veil, ending the war, but his death breaks down the barrier and merges the spirit and mortal realms.
